items.t: General Mills (GIS) Reviews International Ice Cream Business Outside North America
items.sum: General Mills (NYSE:GIS) is reviewing options for its international Haagen-Dazs ice cream business outside North America. The review could include a sale, joint venture, or restructuring of Haagen-Dazs operations in markets such as Europe and Asia.
